title: A Sea Glass Dream - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
A SEA GLASS DREAM Highlights:

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 📍 GREAT location within WaterColor — 1 min to Frog Pool, 2 mins to Camp WaterColor, 4 mins to Beach Club & 4 mins to Seaside by bike 🏊‍♀️ Up to 8 wristbands (ages 5+) for access to resort pools, including WaterColor Beach Club & Camp WaterColor featuring a lazy river, slides & kids’ play areas 🏎️ 2024 lifted 6-seater street-legal golf cart with lithium-ion battery for longer rides 🚲 4 YOLO beach cruiser bikes included 🚶‍♀️ Walk, bike, or golf cart to Seaside (free golf cart parking at the square!) 🛶 Kayaks & paddleboards available at Western Lake 🌲 Miles of scenic nature & biking trails 🎾 Tennis & pickleball courts nearby 🩴 Backpack beach chairs, umbrellas & beach toys provided 🎲 Games & puzzles for family fun ⚡ High-speed internet & Smart TVs throughout the home 👑 Two primary king en-suites — one on each floor 👶 Family-friendly amenities: Pack ’n Play (bring sheets), highchair, baby gates & bathtub 🛋️ Recently updated with designer finishes 🪷 Spacious front porch featuring a relaxing bed swing 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen with drip coffee maker, Keurig, blender, Crock Pot & air fryer 📺 Smart TVs & cable in all bedrooms 🧊 Stand-alone ice maker — no need to buy ice! 🔥 Gas fireplace 🥩 Propane grill 🧺 ALL linens laundered after every checkout — including comforters

Welcome to A Sea Glass Dream – a designer 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat in the heart of WaterColor, one of 30A’s most sought-after communities.

This home sleeps 8 and blends coastal charm with modern luxury. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and multiple resort-style pools.

From the moment you arrive, the Southern porch—with its swing and Adirondack chairs—sets the tone for relaxation. Inside, vaulted ceilings, a striking two-story gas fireplace, and sunlit shiplap interiors create an inviting space for gathering.

The open kitchen is a chef’s delight, featuring quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and seating for 12 between the dining table and breakfast bar.

Each of the three bedrooms is beautifully appointed, offering a restful escape after sun-filled days.

Spend mornings biking scenic trails, afternoons at the Beach Club’s gulf-front pools and dining venues, and evenings exploring Seaside’s iconic shops and restaurants—just minutes away.

Whether you’re planning a multi-generational family trip or a coastal getaway with friends, A Sea Glass Dream offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and access to the very best of 30A living.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS

FIRST FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Half Bath off Kitchen

SECOND FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Twin bunk bed & Private Bathroom with Shower - Landing Area: Two Twin Beds - Upstairs nook: Twin Day Bed

WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:

🏆 Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S. 🌊 499-acre coastal resort & residential community 🚲 Ideal bike community — perfect for family getaways 🏖️ Pristine sugar-white sand beaches 🏊‍♀️ 6 swimming pools 🥒 Pickleball courts 🎾 Award-winning tennis facilities ⛳ Championship golf nearby 🌅 World-Famous Beach Club 🍽️ Unparalleled beachside, poolside & lakeside dining 🌳 Acres of parks, gardens & footpaths 🏞️ Nearby state parks & nature preserves

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation. *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
Bathrooms: Bathroom 2 - Combination Tub/Shower, Shower, Toilet, Tub
